question: How do I keep travel notes?

sections.title: Open trip notes for the current trip
items: Plantour opens the Trip notes page for the currently selected trip.
sections.afterHtml: If the wrong trip opens, select the correct trip first and then return to Notes.

sections.title: Add, update, or delete a trip note
sections.beforeHtml: Use trip notes when you want to keep travel information, plans, reminders, or image-based references inside the selected trip.
items: Use Add to create a new trip note.
Optionally choose an activity if you want to connect the note to one activity.
Enter note content in the editor. Plantour requires meaningful content before saving.
Select a saved note and use Update to edit it, or Delete to remove it.

sections.title: Use the notes editor
items: The editor toolbar lets you format text with bold, italic, underline, strike, headings, bullet lists, ordered lists, block quotes, links, and unlink.
Use Image URL when you want to insert an image from a public link that starts with http:// or https://.
When you reopen a note, Plantour restores the saved rich-text content and image references in the editor.

sections.title: Review notes, connect them to activities, and export them
items: Use the list filters such as Filter by Title and Activity when you want to narrow the notes list.
Use the page menu option Show Activity Select or Hide Activity Select when you want to show or hide the activity selector in the list.
Mark notes with Mark for PDF when you want to include them in an exported document.
Use Download Marked Notes PDF from the page menu when you want a PDF export of the marked notes only.
